title: Candidate review-accounting seam contract v2
description: Machine-readable seam contract frozen by U0 (plan v3, sha256 1f7cd6d13c65457581d84e8f30810549f177cdea9c2a9c18462b668183ec5e7e). Describes the five capabilities that the candidate runtime MUST provide natively (callers, preconditions, atomic persistence, generation/watermark, idempotency, typed failures, readback) plus the 25-probe behavioral surface re-derived from the Phase A receipt at e2427daf. Amendment rule: any change is recorded as a decision with the contract version bumped and the digest recomputed; U6 judges against a specific contract SHA.

supersedes.const: seam-contract/1 (implicit, never frozen as a document)

amendment_rule.description: Amendments are recorded as decisions with the contract version bumped and the digest recomputed. U6 judges against a specific contract SHA.

contract_gaps_at_phase_a.description: The five structural gaps the Phase A receipt recorded. All five are addressed by capabilities C1-C5.

probes.description: Frozen probe suite: the 25 re-derived behavioral probes plus the new per-capability probes U1-U5. Each probe has an ID, the capability it exercises, its expected typed result, and its proof domain. The suite is pinned by digest and approved under the maker-independence rule.

traceability.description: plan-v2 line -> contract clause -> probe IDs -> unit. Machine-checkable: U6 diffs contract vs receipt mechanically.

plan_ref.description: Governing plan v2 line reference, e.g. 'plan v2:147'.

clause.description: Contract clause ID (capability ID or named clause).

unit.description: Unit that implements (U0-U6), or 'existing' for the baseline surface.

who.description: The only authorized caller of this capability.

module_surface.description: Candidate module(s) expected to own it.

atomic_persistence.description: What must persist in ONE transaction, and the isolation mechanism.

generation_watermark.description: Generation/watermark/fence semantics, or null if not applicable.

idempotency.description: Replay behavior. Replay never revives expired/refunded state.

typed_failures.description: Typed refusal codes; fail closed, no silent fallback.

readback.description: Supported read-only readback path; reads never create/extend/alter authority.

implementation_unit.description: U1-U5 unit that implements, per plan v3 sequencing U0->U4->U1->(U2+U5)->U3->U6.

kind.description: behavioral | capability | adversarial | boundary | concurrency | environmental

expected_result.description: Typed expected result; PASS means observed exactly this, no fallback.

domain.description: Where it runs: isolated temp HERMES_HOME+board on tower, Linux-only, etc.

phase_a_evidence.description: For re-derived probes: the Phase A receipt probe ID this re-derives, and any baseline change declaration.
